title: Projects and Goals are app-only: no agent store kind, tool, or title access
current_behavior: The app creates and syncs projects and goals through /api/v3/sync; the agent's ADR-032 store covers only tasks, calendar events, finance and health records; goals reach the kernel only as id/status/priority snapshots without titles; projects are invisible to the agent.
expected_behavior: ADR-032's shared-store premise holds for every synced Personal-OS table: the agent can list and create projects and goals with titles decrypted under the user data key.
recommendation: Add RecordKind.PROJECT/GOAL and matching _Table rows to the synced store, generate CRUD tools in records.py, let PostgresGoalsPort decrypt title_enc via user_data_keys, and cover it in test_personal_os_sync_integration.py against real Postgres.

title: Reachability matrix over-credits callers (UI route paths, method-blind split matches, test files)
current_behavior: Two of 77 'called' rows (POST /api/v3/chat, GET /admin/learning/jobs/{job_id}) have no real caller; test files count as callers; GET and POST on the same path are indistinguishable.
expected_behavior: tests/architecture/test_api_reachability.py passes only when production code builds the route with the right HTTP method.
recommendation: Exclude tests/ and test/ directories, require the match to sit in a string that also carries /api/v or a known base-URL assignment, record the verb next to the call, and re-triage POST /chat as API/service-key only.

title: No client sends Idempotency-Key; GAP-013 claims it does
evidence: rg -i idempotency aura_client (excluding build dirs) -> 0 files
current_behavior: Retried writes to /knowledge/documents, /memory, /feedback and /engineering/workspaces/{id} are never deduplicated; the server-side idempotency machinery has zero callers.
expected_behavior: Every side-effecting client write carries a per-attempt key so a retry after a timeout cannot duplicate the effect.
recommendation: Send the header from KnowledgeCenter, MemoryRepository, FeedbackRepository and EngineerWorkspaces; pin with a test; correct GAP-013's reverified text.

title: Operator console unreachable on every live target; 32 admin routes operable only through the raw API
current_behavior: Railway serves the backend only; the console image exists only for the VPS stack that takes no deploys; ADR-029 service-key issuance, scorecard, erasure-job polling and all Track AP operations have no UI, and the mock gateway covers 11 of 36 proxied paths.
expected_behavior: An operator surface deployed alongside the backend, with every operator-facing route reachable from it or declared API-only.
recommendation: Owner decides hosting (Railway service for aura_admin or the VPS once deploys work); then wire service-keys, jobs/{task_id}, scorecard and refresh/latest into existing pages and extend mock-gateway.mjs; AP9 stays a roadmap item.

title: Daemon pairing succeeds for accounts the host socket will refuse; app cannot revoke a paired daemon
evidence: no caller for /api/v3/auth/desktop/devices/revoke in aura_client/lib or aura_hostd
current_behavior: With AURA_ENGINEER_AGENT_ROLES unset (default) pairing completes and stores a token, then every WebSocket connection is closed 4401 with no actionable message; a paired device can only be revoked server-side.
expected_behavior: Pairing fails fast with the reason when the account cannot host; the app lists and revokes paired devices.
recommendation: Check engineer_agent at /pair/approve (403 engineer_agent_required); add a device list and a devices/revoke caller to host_panel.dart / host_daemon_page.dart; document the env var in the hostd README.

title: Five user-facing read routes still have no client view five weeks after triage; four learning routes have no caller at all
current_behavior: /tools, /agents/runs[/{id}], /knowledge/graph[/entities/{key}] are reachable only by hand-built requests; /learning/* has no consumer anywhere.
expected_behavior: Each route has a consumer or is removed / declared API-only with an owner and date.
recommendation: Wire /tools into settings, extend the Engineer history tab to /agents/runs, add a graph view to the knowledge page; remove api/learning.py or fold its export into /admin/learning/datasets/{digest}.

title: Dead dev.aureon-ai.tech preset still selectable in the app
current_behavior: Choosing the development environment points the app at a host that no longer resolves, and setEnvironment() clears tokens without revoking them.
expected_behavior: Only reachable presets are offered, or the switch probes /health/ready first and refuses.
recommendation: Drop or re-point the dev preset; probe before switching.

title: ADR-032 key fetch depends on migration 0019 while production is claimed at 0016
current_behavior: Until 0019 is applied live, GET /api/v3/keys/data fails and devices stay on per-device keys; agent writes to the synced tables cannot be read by devices.
expected_behavior: Deploy ordering documented and verified: migrate, confirm /health/ready schema.revision 0019, then ship the client.
recommendation: Follow CB-28's exit criteria; no code change.
